name: vllm-rocm-halo
description: vLLM runtime for AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151) ASSEMBLED from AMD's ROCm/vllm `gfx11`-branch wheel (vllm-wheel-halo-gfx11). Uses the pinned InferStation ROCm 7.15.0a20260719 multi-arch Halo base so torch/ROCm ABI matches the wheel builder, and backports vLLM PRs #38824 and #39018 for Gemma4 head size 512 and 64 KiB shared-memory devices. This is the DEFAULT halo vLLM line (repo renamed from vllm-rocm-halo-gfx11). gfx11 ships AMD's gfx1151-tuned kernels and retains FusedMoE.tp_size (AWQ MoE loads cleanly), at the cost of trailing upstream main (no DiffusionGemma; use vllm-rocm-halo-main for that). Rebuild the wheel pkg first whenever the base image changes.
